items.title: American Airlines (Fully) Resolves Catering Mess At Heathrow After 5 Months Of Stopgaps
items.summary: Austrian catering company DO & CO has been selected by American Airlines to be its permanent London Heathrow caterer, five months after the oneworld carrier had to adjust its catering options at the airline's largest international outstation.
